legal.t1_body: By booking a service through YMV Limo ("we", "us", or "our"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use our platform.
legal.t2_body: YMV Limo provides premium intercity and hourly chauffeur services in the greater Houston area and across Texas. All bookings are subject to vehicle and driver availability. We reserve the right to assign any suitable vehicle from our fleet.
legal.t3_body: A valid credit or debit card is required to complete a booking. Your card is saved securely via Stripe and will be charged after your trip is completed or per the cancellation policy below. The fare shown at booking is an estimate — the final amount is confirmed by the admin after vehicle assignment.
legal.t4_rule3_value: Full fare charged. Our driver will wait up to 30 minutes past the scheduled pickup time before the booking is marked as a no-show.
legal.t4_note: Cancellations must be made through the My Bookings page. Cancellations requested via WhatsApp or phone are not accepted and will not be processed.
legal.t5_body: You agree to be at the designated pickup location on time and to treat our vehicles and drivers with respect. Any damage caused to a vehicle by a passenger will be the passenger's financial responsibility. YMV Limo is not responsible for items left in vehicles.
legal.t6_body: Any services, agreements, or payments arranged directly between the client and the chauffeur outside of this platform are not the responsibility of YMV Limo. Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the affected booking.
legal.t7_body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
